title: Sales Representative sits under Service Advisor and reads Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card without hovering over it.
  2. Find the Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card shows Lead Technician, then Service Advisor, then a field labelled "Sales Representative" directly under Service Advisor.
  • Step 2: the label "Sales Representative" is on the first line and "Unassigned" on the second. At rest there is no box around it, no dropdown arrow and no button beside it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R1: “The work order card shows a Sales Representative field directly under Service Advisor.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”
  • S1-R3: “At rest the field shows no box, no dropdown arrow and no buttons beside it.”
  • S1-R7: “With nobody assigned, the field reads "Unassigned".”
